descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S23 「完成之后，到保留窗口时：已完成和保留的任务、记录窗口、用药行、明天的总结，以及养老院的「最近两次就诊」规则」 After completion, at the retention windows: completed and kept tasks, the note window, medication rows, tomorrow's summary and the Nursing Home last-two-visits rule

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U13 Retention after completion (3.6). Hospital: tasks kept with 'Keep & complete' stay open and clear 36 h after the chart was last processed; completed tasks clear at 16 h; …（UAT 3.6；TFA-92595 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T7 The Note tab shows tomorrow's Pre-Round summary underneath the note.（TFA-92595 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Hospital patient completed with 'Keep Tasks & Mark Complete' (two open, one done), with a generated note, tracker rows and a saved Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary; Nursing Home resident completed with open tasks, a note and medication events on each of three visits

When With the aging helper, reopen the Hospital chart at +15 h / +17 h (completed tasks, 16 h), +17 h / +19 h (note, 18 h: the Post-Round Note tab and Copy to EMR), +20 h (tomorrow's Pre-Round), then with the chart left unprocessed at +35 h / +37 h (open tasks and medication rows, 36 h). Nursing Home: record a third visit

Then Done task present at +15 h, gone at +17 h. At +17 h the Note tab shows today's note; at +19 h neither the Post-Round Note tab nor the clipboard after Copy to EMR presents it as today's note (at most the previous note). Kept open tasks and the summary show on Pre-Round at +20 h. At +35 h the open tasks and medication rows are still there; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.6 windows, read on the chart and confirmed with a query each time (a real deletion, not a UI hide); the clipboard is read after each Copy. The server-clock rule (3.8) is U15 in S25

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S23 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-17.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
